title: Fictional sampling result for RSK-110 capability classification

assessor.name: Morgan Ellis
assessor.independence_statement: This fictional assessor has no operational ownership of the assessed Summit Analytics CAP-140 capability.

assessment_scope.subject: Fictional Summit Analytics workforce-research assistant CAP-140
assessment_scope.boundary: Risk classification record and criteria application for CAP-140 during the engagement period.
assessment_scope.population: Fictional RSK controls assigned to CAP-140.

methods.procedure: RSK-110-A1 - Examine the fictional CAP-140 classification record for required factors.
methods.expected_result: Classification addresses impact, likelihood, autonomy, data sensitivity, affected parties, and obligations.
methods.actual_work: Examined the fictional classification body, rationale, reviewers, and approval metadata for 2026-06-01 through 2026-08-31.

methods.procedure: RSK-110-A2 - Independently apply criteria to the fictional CAP-140 sample.
methods.expected_result: Independent application yields a classification consistent with the recorded result.

determination_rationale: The fictional classification is approved and addresses required factors, but audience-expansion trigger criteria remain incomplete, keeping the operating picture only partially supported.

findings.statement: Fictional classification names audience expansion as a change trigger but lacks concrete reclassification criteria.

disposition.action: Update fictional classification to add explicit audience-expansion trigger criteria.
disposition.rationale: Trigger clarity is required before any final determination.

limitations: This fictional Draft deepen result does not assess a real organization.
Independent criteria Test covered only one fictional capability.
